title: Grateful Dead Live at NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadows Park on 1969-07-12
venue: NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadows Park
source: Partial SBD Recording Info: Pat Lee from Dick Latvala 1985; Technics 1506> Yamaha K2000 MSC > R > C > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a solid remaster but noticeable tuning issues on St Stephen; China Cat Sunflower shines.
ai_review.review: The tape has been praised for its good remaster and clear soundboard source, yet listeners note that the band sounded out of tune during St Stephen. China Cat Sunflower is highlighted as a standout track, while overall energy feels uneven due to the tuning hiccup.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates it 4 / 5 for sound quality and a strong China Cat, another gives a 0 rating with vague criticism; the mixed feedback yields an average rating around the mid‑range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered sound is clear and well‑balanced, typical of a soundboard source; no major dropouts or hiss reported.
